title: General.
officialText:
Plastering gypsum plaster or cement plaster shall not be less than three coats where applied over metal lath or
wire fabric lath and not less than two coats where applied over other bases permitted by this chapter.
Exception: Gypsum veneer plaster and cement plaster specifically designed and approved for one-coat applications.
